result.instructions: Tools for Synthesia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the video templates in my workspace and show their variables."; "Create a test video with one scene: a stock avatar reading a short product update."; "Show my last five videos and which ones are complete.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Synthesia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run synthesia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run synthesia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run synthesia_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. synthesia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: synthesia_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the video templates in the workspace, with their variables. Use this first to find a template id before building a video from one. Synthesia API: GET /v2/templates.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: synthesia_list_videos
tools.title: List videos
tools.description: List the videos in the account, including their status (in_progress, complete or error). Synthesia API: GET /v2/videos.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: synthesia_get_video
tools.title: Get a video
tools.description: Get one video by id: its status and, once status is complete, a time-limited download URL. Rendering takes minutes, so poll this tool on demand. Synthesia API: GET /v2/videos/{id}.

video_id.description: The video id (from synthesia_list_videos or synthesia_create_video).

tools.name: synthesia_create_video
tools.title: Create a video
tools.description: Start rendering an AI video from one or more scenes. Each scene has the spoken script, an avatar id and a background id. Creating a video uses the account's quota; set test to true for a free test video with a Synthesia background (it does not count against quota). Returns the new video id; poll synthesia_get_video until its status is complete. Synthesia API: POST /v2/videos.

title.description: Video title shown in Synthesia Studio.

test.description: true = free test video with a Synthesia background (default false).

script_text.description: The text the avatar speaks in this scene.

avatar.description: Avatar id, e.g. anna_costume1_cameraA (see the Synthesia avatar list).
